Hi team,

Thanks for the quick intro — excited to get Hartwell Health's profile live in Whistic so your procurement/security team has everything they need. A couple quick asks so we can scope the first upload and evidence cadence: 

- Which portal are you preferring for the initial exchange (Whistic / Vendr / custom S3 upload)?
- Primary evidence items you need up front: SOC 2 Type II report, encryption-at-rest details, key management (KMS/HSM) evidence, and network segmentation diagram. Are there any additional questionnaires (CAIQ / SIG) you want included in the first pass?
- Preferred rotation cadence for evidence (quarterly / semi-annual / annual)?

Proposed next steps:
1) We attach a mapping that shows where our standard artifacts map to Whistic sections (redwood_whistic_mapping_v1.xlsx).
2) If you confirm Whistic, we can upload on your behalf (need a contact with upload permissions) or share a link for you to accept.
3) Quick 30-min call to confirm any custom Qs — I’m available Tue/Wed 10–12 PT.

Attachment: redwood_whistic_mapping_v1.xlsx (mapping & suggested docs)

Hi Mina — thanks for the note. We are using Whistic for our assessments. A few specifics from our side: 

- Please upload a current AWS architecture diagram showing subnets, VPC peering, and any cross-account roles (we need it for our VA review).
- Evidence rotation: Hartwell prefers quarterly refresh for high-risk items (SOC2 attestations can be annual, but config screenshots and key-rotation logs quarterly).
- We also need confirmation of any third-party subprocessors and a redacted contract list (just vendor name + purpose is fine).

I’ve attached our preferred diagram template (hartwell_aws_diagram.pdf). If you can upload to Whistic, please tag the SOC2 asset and CAIQ snapshot.
